def decode_blob(data):
    # expensive pure-Python expansion of binary input
    return memoryview(data).tobytes()

def handle_job(job):
    pages = []
    for asset in job.assets:
        payload = decode_blob(asset.data)
        pages.append(render_asset(payload))
    return pages
